title: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit
shortDescription: Generic circuit malfunction on the left front wheel speed sensor.
fullDescription: DTC C0035: Generic circuit malfunction on the left front wheel speed sensor. ABS-related codes in the C0035-C0080 range typically indicate wheel speed sensor or hydraulic solenoid circuit issues. Diagnosis usually starts with the affected wheel.
safetyImpact: ABS, traction control, and stability systems are disabled. Reduced braking performance in emergency or low-traction situations.

causes.cause: Damaged tone ring / reluctor or hub assembly

symptoms: Brake system warning light may also illuminate

fixSteps.title: Scan ABS Module
fixSteps.instruction: Use a bidirectional scan tool capable of reading ABS / chassis codes. Capture the affected wheel and freeze-frame data.

fixSteps.title: Inspect Sensor and Wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Raise the vehicle, locate the affected wheel speed sensor, and inspect for damage, debris, and wiring integrity.

fixSteps.title: Test Sensor
fixSteps.instruction: For passive sensors, measure resistance (typically 1-2 kΩ). For active sensors, back-probe and look for a square-wave signal while spinning the wheel.

fixSteps.title: Replace Sensor or Hub
fixSteps.instruction: Replace the faulty sensor or hub assembly (if integrated). Torque to spec, clear codes, and road test to confirm repair.

faq.q: Is it safe to drive with an ABS / wheel speed sensor code?
faq.a: Standard hydraulic brakes still function, but ABS, traction control, and stability control are disabled. Drive cautiously and avoid hard braking on slick surfaces.

faq.q: Can debris really cause a wheel speed sensor code?
faq.a: Yes — a small piece of metal stuck to the sensor face can disrupt the magnetic signal and trigger a fault.

faq.q: Do I need to replace the whole hub?
faq.a: On many modern vehicles the sensor is integrated into the hub bearing assembly. Check the parts catalog before ordering.
